summary: This topic explains how to define new subjects in the ERP system, including assigning a unique code, selecting an assessment model, and optionally mapping to specific classes or streams. It also details rules for editing subjects.
steps: Navigate to the subject definition section within Academics.
Enter the 'Name of the subject' (e.g., English).
Enter a 'Unique code' for the subject (e.g., ENG).
Select an 'Assessment model' from the available options (e.g., Scholastic, Co-scholastic, Discipline, Skills).
Optionally, select specific 'Class and Stream' if the subject should only be available for particular classes during mapping.
business_rules: The subject code is a mandatory field.
The subject code defines the subject itself, not the class it is taught in.
Co-scholastic, Discipline, or Skills subjects typically use grading criteria.
important_notes: Subjects can only be edited (name, code, assessment model) if they have not yet been mapped to any class.
If a subject is already mapped to a class, only its display name can be changed from the subject class mapping section, not the original subject name.
